item.title: Ordinary Lab Gloves May Have Skewed Microplastic Data
item.description:
📝 Featured VideoA team of researchers from the University of Michigan discovered that nitrile and latex gloves traditionally worn by laboratory scientists of all stripes, can shed particles called “stearates” that mimic microplastics. ”Previous research found that disposable gloves used in wet preparations of samples could skew microplastics data, but this is the first study to find similar activity in dry preparations. Most importantly, the researchers stress this doesn’t mean there’s no such thing as microplastic pollution, just that scientists studying it should refine their methodology.
🔗 Read more: https://nautil.us/ordinary-lab-gloves-may-have-skewed-microplastic-data-1279386
